# House style reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from the source. Do not edit by hand: change the code and re-run it. -->

The house style: one look shared by every repo, decided element by element in the style review (REV-001).

Base drafting is the clean bracket sheet's (flat blue, crisp lines, monospace lettering, light-blue dimension ink). The aged tag-clip sheet contributes the
paper ageing, the approved stamp and the deadpan winks, each of which a repo can switch off in its config.

Text sizes and line widths are in points on a figure drawn at true sheet size, so 1 sheet mm is 1 mm on the printed page.

## Spacing

Sheet-millimetre distances used by the layout and the annotation helpers.

| Name | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `margin` | `10.0` | paper edge to the outer border line |
| `border_gap` | `2.0` | outer to inner border line |
| `view_gap` | `26.0` | between neighbouring views, room for a dimension and a caption |
| `dim_offset` | `8.0` | dimension line distance from its view |
| `extension_gap` | `1.2` | gap between the part and an extension line |
| `extension_overrun` | `1.5` | extension line run past its dimension line |
| `caption_drop` | `7.0` | caption distance below a view's lowest annotation |
| `centre_overrun` | `2.5` | centre mark run past a circle |

## Toggles

Per-repo switches for the parts of the house style that are personality rather than drafting.

| Name | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `aged` | `True` | paper grain, blotches, fold creases and vignette |
| `grid` | `False` | faint 10 mm graph grid |
| `stamp` | `True` | the approved rubber stamp |
| `winks` | `True` | deadpan captions on the projection symbol, size field, centring marks, standards footer and tolerance block |
| `credit` | `True` | a small line in the bottom margin naming and linking the generator |

## Sheet sizes

|---|---|---|
| B | 431.8 × 279.4 | 11 × 17, THE TABLOID ONE |
| C | 558.8 × 431.8 | 17 × 22, THE PLOTTER ONE |

## Standard scales

The automatic layout uses the largest of these that fits: 5:1, 4:1, 3:1, 2:1, 1.5:1, 1:1, 1:1.33, 1:2, 1:2.5, 1:4, 1:5, 1:10.
